QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off. ... This program needs `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (guard at line 24).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros as the gating mechanism: THREADING_C gates all mutex use, and both are required by the pthread program.
